subject: ArmPkg/Driver: use ArmFfaGetPartitionInfo() in Mmcommunication
reasons: The same migration appears in both DXE and PEI MM communication files.
There is a clear before/after pattern: remove manual partition-info retrieval and replace it with the new helper.
This is classic collateral evolution across multiple call sites.
The transformation is mechanical enough to be expressed as a semantic patch.
candidate_pattern: Replace manual FF-A partition lookup and buffer-release boilerplate with `ArmFfaGetPartitionInfo()` and direct `PartitionId` access.
